summary: HTTP MCP requires authentication plus TLS for non-loopback listeners, and credential setup uses hidden terminal input or piped standard input while rejecting non-interactive modes that can inherit an unreadable pipe.
reason: AMC tools can use operator credentials and mutate local agent state; callers must not receive replayable plaintext network credentials, and setup must not expose the vendor key through argv, shell history, or terminal echo.
validated_outcome: Unit coverage verifies HTTP authorization, rejection of plaintext remote binds, hidden credential input, immediate rejection under --agent/--no-input, stdin parsing, and rejection of credential argv.
